<template><div /></template>
<style>
/* 日本 🧭 */
.demo {
  color: #ff0000;
  background-color: rgb(0 128 255 / 50%);
  border-color: hsl(120 100% 25%);
  outline-color: red;
  --theme: #abc;
  content: "#123456";
}
</style>

**color**

_CSS property_

Sets the color of an element's text

**Syntax**

```css
<color>
```

**Baseline (catalog snapshot)**

Widely available; interoperable since 2015-07-29; widely available since 2018-01-29

**Docs**

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/color)

**red**

_CSS value for outline-color_

#ff0000

**Example**

```css
outline-color: red;
```

**Property syntax**

```css
auto | <color>
```

**Docs**

[MDN CSS named colors](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/named-color)

**Docs**

[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/outline-color)
